description: FastMCP Server delivering 6 deterministic physical AI oracles (Terrain, Weather, Geofence, RF SatCom, Energy Routing, Risk Underwriting & Insurance).

tools.name: analyze_geo_terrain_physics

tools.name: analyze_micro_weather_turbulence
tools.description: Calculate 3D wind velocity vectors, boundary layer wind shear, EDR turbulence, and drone flight stability.

tools.name: check_airspace_geofence_regulation
tools.description: Check Class A-G airspace classifications, airport No-Fly Zones (NFZ), and UTM compliance status.

tools.name: analyze_rf_coverage_satcom

tools.name: plan_energy_optimal_trajectory
tools.description: Compute 3D energy-optimal waypoint path minimizing battery Watt-hour consumption and gravitational potential work.

tools.name: underwrite_mission_risk_and_insurance

tools.name: verify_parametric_insurance_claim
